# R5a evals — Calm fixes found in the browser (weights, Home fit, policies cards, policy detail)

> Base for every diff is the literal `$(git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/build/evals/R5a.md)` (shell substitutes it). Run from the worktree root under bash or zsh. Written from spec R5a.1 to R5a.8, not from builder code. No database, no paid API, localhost only. Do not print `.env*`.
>
> Playwright always: `KV_E2E_PORT=3312 npx playwright test -c playwright.real.config.ts e2e/real-screens.spec.ts ...`.
> Shorthand used below: `S=e2e/real-screens.spec.ts`, `D=src/components`, `M=$D/cover-real`.
> Folders (R5a.3): `access agent chat cover cover-real covers family help money onboarding palette profile shell tools ui upload wallet` under `src/components/`.

R5a-01. Scope: changed plus untracked paths are only allowed files — cmd: `{ git diff --name-only $(git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/build/evals/R5a.md); git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep . | grep -vE '^(src/styles/app-theme\.css|src/components/(access|agent|chat|cover|cover-real|covers|family|help|money|onboarding|palette|profile|shell|tools|ui|upload|wallet)/.*\.module\.css|src/components/public/(signin|legal)\.module\.css|src/components/cover-real/(MemoryDocument\.tsx|RealHome\.tsx|RealPolicies\.tsx|RealPolicyDetail\.tsx)|e2e/real-screens\.spec\.ts|e2e/real-account\.ts|tests/.*)$'; echo "stray-done"` — expect: no line before `stray-done` — PASS if every changed or untracked path is in the allowed set.

R5a-02. Not-edited files unchanged — cmd: `git diff --name-only $(git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/build/evals/R5a.md) -- src/styles/tokens.css src/styles/globals.css src/components/type/type.module.css src/components/public/landing.module.css src/components/public/tones.module.css src/components/public/Landing.tsx src/components/public/Tour.tsx src/components/cover-real/parts.tsx src/adapters src/app package.json package-lock.json; echo "unchanged-done"` — expect: no line before `unchanged-done` — PASS if none of the not-edited files, `src/adapters`, `src/app`, `package.json`, `package-lock.json` differ from base.

R5a-03. No thin or normal weight left in listed modules — cmd: `D=src/components; grep -rnE --include='*.module.css' 'font: (300|400) |font-weight: *(300|400|normal)' $D/access $D/agent $D/chat $D/cover $D/cover-real $D/covers $D/family $D/help $D/money $D/onboarding $D/palette $D/profile $D/shell $D/tools $D/ui $D/upload $D/wallet 2>/dev/null; grep -nE 'font: (300|400) |font-weight: *(300|400|normal)' $D/public/signin.module.css $D/public/legal.module.css; echo "weights-done"` — expect: no line before `weights-done` — PASS if no match in any listed module or the two public files.

R5a-04. Weight edit only changed weights in CSS modules — cmd: `git diff -U0 $(git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/build/evals/R5a.md) -- 'src/components/**/*.module.css' | grep -E '^[-+]' | grep -vE '^(\+\+\+|---)' | grep -E '^[-+]' | grep -vE 'font(-weight)?: *(300|400|normal|500)'; echo "other-edits-done"` — expect: only lines before `other-edits-done` belong to `policies.module.css` or `RealHome.module.css` (R5a.4 to R5a.6 layout edits); no line from any other module — PASS if lines shown come only from those two files. Check by running the same command with `-- ':!src/components/cover-real/policies.module.css' ':!src/components/cover-real/RealHome.module.css'` added after `--`: output before `other-edits-done` must be empty.

R5a-05. app-theme.css adds only the h1 rule — cmd: `grep -qF '.kv-app h1 { font-weight: 500; }' src/styles/app-theme.css && echo rule-ok; git diff -U0 $(git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/build/evals/R5a.md) -- src/styles/app-theme.css | grep -E '^[-+]' | grep -vE '^(\+\+\+|---)'` — expect: `rule-ok`, then no removed line and added lines are the rule plus at most one comment line (`/* ... */` or `//`) — PASS if exactly that.

R5a-06. MemoryDocument inline sizes and weights raised — cmd: `grep -nE 'fontSize: *(1[0-5]|[0-9])\b|fontWeight: *(300|400|normal)' src/components/cover-real/MemoryDocument.tsx; echo "memdoc-done"; git diff --stat $(git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/build/evals/R5a.md) -- src/components/cover-real/MemoryDocument.tsx | tail -1` — expect: no line before `memdoc-done`, then a diffstat showing the file changed — PASS if no fontSize under 16 (including 12, 13, 14, 15) or fontWeight 300/400 remains and the file did change.

R5a-07. Home: root and media rule — cmd: `H=src/components/cover-real/RealHome; grep -c 's\.stack' $H.tsx; grep -qF 'rows.page' $H.tsx && echo page-ok; grep -qE '^\.page\b' $H.module.css && echo css-page-ok; grep -qF '@media (max-height: 860px)' $H.module.css && echo media-ok; grep -qF '36px' $H.module.css && grep -qF '26px' $H.module.css && echo sizes-ok; grep -nE 'font-size: *([0-9]|1[0-5])(\.[0-9]+)?px' $H.module.css; echo "small-done"` — expect: `0`, `page-ok`, `css-page-ok`, `media-ok`, `sizes-ok`, then nothing before `small-done` — PASS if `.stack` is gone from `RealHome.tsx`, `.page`, the media rule, 36px and 26px exist, and no font-size under 16px.

R5a-08. Policies and detail pinned markup and CSS — cmd: `M=src/components/cover-real; P=$M/RealPolicies.tsx; Q=$M/RealPolicyDetail.tsx; C=$M/policies.module.css; for s in 'PAGE_SIZE = 4' 'data-testid="policy-count"' 'data-testid="policy-card"' 'Needs your decision' 'Not found yet'; do grep -qF -- "$s" $P || echo "MISSING P $s"; done; for s in 'FACT_PAGE = 6' 'data-testid="headlines"' 'headline-' 'data-tone' 'Review and decide'; do grep -qF -- "$s" $Q || echo "MISSING Q $s"; done; grep -nE "import[^;]*\bHeadlines\b[^;]*from *['\"]\./parts" $Q; grep -qF 'grid-auto-rows: minmax(0, 1fr)' $C || echo "MISSING grid-auto-rows"; grep -nEi '#[0-9a-f]{3,8}\b|box-shadow|text-shadow|gradient|blur|@keyframes' $C; grep -nE 'font-size: *([0-9]|1[0-5])(\.[0-9]+)?px' $C; grep -nE 'font-weight: *([0-9]|[1-4][0-9][0-9])\b' $C; echo "pinned-done"` — expect: no line at all before `pinned-done` — PASS if every pinned string is present, `Headlines` is not imported from `./parts`, and `policies.module.css` has no hex colour, shadow, gradient, blur, keyframes, font-size under 16px or font-weight under 500.

R5a-09. Harness spec: rename, 11 tests, screenshots calm, expectCalm untouched — cmd: `S=e2e/real-screens.spec.ts; B=$(git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/build/evals/R5a.md); grep -qF 'a group of nine facts pages at six' $S && echo new-title-ok; grep -qF 'a group of nine facts pages at eight' $S && echo OLD-TITLE-STILL; grep -cE '^\s*test\(' $S; perl -0ne 'while(/page\.screenshot\(\{.*?\}\)/gs){$n++; $b++ unless $&=~/animations:\s*"disabled"/} print "calls=",$n+0," bad=",$b+0,"\n"' $S; f() { awk '/(function|const) expectCalm/{f=1} f{print} f&&/^}/{exit}'; }; git show $B:$S | f > "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r5a-calm-base.txt"; f < $S > "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r5a-calm-now.txt"; test -s "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r5a-calm-base.txt" && diff "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r5a-calm-base.txt" "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r5a-calm-now.txt" && echo calm-identical` — expect: `new-title-ok`, no `OLD-TITLE-STILL`, `11`, `calls=N bad=0` with N at least 1, `calm-identical` — PASS if all hold.

R5a-10. Decisive: full harness passes 11 of 11 — cmd: `KV_E2E_PORT=3312 npx playwright test -c playwright.real.config.ts e2e/real-screens.spec.ts > "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r5a-pw.txt" 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"; grep -E '[0-9]+ (passed|failed|skipped|flaky|did not run)' "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r5a-pw.txt"` — expect: `rc=0` and exactly one summary line `11 passed` — PASS if rc is 0, `11 passed` appears and no `failed`, `skipped`, `flaky` or `did not run` line. A calm failure here is a FAIL (this task owns the fix).

R5a-11. Unit tests: rename present, none deleted, whole suite green — cmd: `grep -qF 'a group with nine facts pages at six' tests/components/kv-policies.test.tsx && echo unit-title-ok; grep -qF 'a group with nine facts pages at eight' tests/components/kv-policies.test.tsx && echo OLD-UNIT-TITLE; git diff --name-only --diff-filter=D $(git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/build/evals/R5a.md) -- tests; echo "deleted-done"; npx vitest run > "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r5a-vitest.txt" 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"; grep -E 'Tests +[0-9]+|failed' "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r5a-vitest.txt"` — expect: `unit-title-ok`, no `OLD-UNIT-TITLE`, nothing before `deleted-done`, `rc=0`, a `Tests N passed` line and no `failed` — PASS if all hold.

R5a-12. Gates and no leftover server — cmd: `npm run typecheck > "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r5a-tc.txt" 2>&1; echo "tc-rc=$?"; npm run lint > "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r5a-lint.txt" 2>&1; echo "lint-rc=$?"; grep -E '^/' "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r5a-lint.txt" | grep -v 'src/app/layout.tsx'; echo "lint-files-done"; lsof -ti tcp:3312; echo "port-done"; git diff $(git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/build/evals/R5a.md) | grep -E '^\+' | grep -iE 'secret|password|api_key'; echo "secrets-done"` — expect: `tc-rc=0`, `lint-rc=0`, nothing before `lint-files-done`, no pid before `port-done`, no line before `secrets-done` — PASS if typecheck and lint exit 0 with only `src/app/layout.tsx` ever listed, port 3312 is free, and the diff adds no secret-like word.
